title: Theme/asset read failure renders as zero and never reaches the bell
body:
## Summary
useThemes and useAssets turn a failed IndexedDB read into `[]` plus a local `error` string; unlike useProjects they never publish to the storage-trouble channel, and three of four consumers drop `error` - so on /projects and in the create wizard a failed read is indistinguishable from 'you have no styles'.

## Description
lib/useProjects.ts:95-103 routes every failure through `failed()` -> reportStorageTrouble (the bell knows the five storage kinds and says what to do). lib/useThemes.ts:5 claims to 'Mirror useProjects: errors surface rather than being swallowed', but its catches (:49-52, :73, :142) only setError; lib/useAssets.ts catches (:214-216, :233, :274, :299, :339, :361, :388, :410) likewise - grep reportStorageTrouble in lib/: useProjects.ts and identityEviction.ts only. Consumers that discard `error`: app/projects/ProjectsView.tsx:102 `const { themes } = useThemes(...)`, app/_projects/wizard/CreateWizard.tsx:89 same, app/library/LibraryAtelier.tsx:87 `{ assets, promote, removeFromTheme } = useAssets(...)`. Worst branch: ProjectsView.tsx:105 `gated = themes !== null && lockedThemes.length === 0` - a quota/blocked read sets themes=[] and the page shows the 'lock a style first' gate, a wrong cause with a wrong remedy, while the bell stays silent.

## Flow
- Storage blocked by an older tab -> /projects -> listThemes throws -> themes=[] -> gate says no locked style -> user goes to make one -> the real problem (close the other tab) is never named.
- Library -> assets read fails -> shelf renders empty, 'already on the shelf' marks vanish; nothing says the read failed.

## Expected impact
Every theme/asset storage failure becomes visible in the one operator-visible channel, with the bell's per-kind remedy, regardless of which consumer forgot `error`.

## Evaluation
Claim: user - a failed read of my styles or assets should be named, not shown as an empty shelf
Before: storage-trouble publications from useThemes + useAssets catch blocks: 0 of 11; consumers that render the failure: 1 of 4 (LibraryAtelier's useThemes); /projects shows the lock gate on a read failure
After: 11 of 11 catch blocks publish via reportStorageTrouble (scope e.g. 'themes' / 'assets'), mirroring useProjects.failed; bell carries the failure on every route
Method: probe - source ratchet: stripComments(lib/useThemes.ts / lib/useAssets.ts), every `catch (e)` block that calls setError also calls reportStorageTrouble
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence: lib/useProjects.ts:27,95-103 (reportStorageTrouble); lib/useThemes.ts:5 header claim, :49-52 catch; lib/useAssets.ts:214-216 catch; grep -n reportStorageTrouble lib/* -> useProjects.ts, identityEviction.ts only; ProjectsView.tsx:102,105; CreateWizard.tsx:89; LibraryAtelier.tsx:87.
verify: Give useThemes and useAssets a `failed(op, e, fallback)` callback identical in shape to useProjects.ts:95-103 (reportStorageTrouble(op, '', '<themes|assets>', e) then setError) and call it from every catch. Probe tests/golden-path/storage-trouble-parity.probe.spec.ts: for each of lib/useProjects.ts, lib/useThemes.ts, lib/useAssets.ts, stripComments, split on /catch\s*\(e\)\s*\{/ and assert every catch body that contains `setError` also contains `failed(` or `reportStorageTrouble(` (red on HEAD: useThemes 3 and useAssets 8 bodies fail). Consumer half (ProjectsView.tsx:105 gating on a read failure) is out of this context - note it for ui owners, do not touch.

title: 'Session ended' is tracked but never shown: expiry looks like a random logout
body:
## Summary
useAuth carries `lastTransition` ('signed-out' | 'session-ended' | 'account-switched') specifically so a surface can tell 'you signed out' from 'your session ended'; zero surfaces read it, so an expired session bounces to the landing with no word - after identityEviction has already wiped the local shelf.

## Description
lib/useAuth.tsx:81-85: 'Carried so a surface can tell "you signed out" from "your session ended" - the eviction is identical either way, the narration is not, and treating them alike is what produces the familiar report of being "randomly logged out".' grep -rn lastTransition app components lib tests (excluding useAuth.tsx): 0 hits. On a Firebase-side expiry onAuthStateChanged fires null (useAuth.tsx:129-146), transitionFor returns 'session-ended', evictIdentity wipes projects/steps/themes/assets/jobs, components/ui/AuthGate.tsx:21-23 router.replace('/') - and app/_landing/parts.tsx:30-80 EnterButton renders only `error` (sign-in failures). The three transitions and a first-ever visit all render the identical landing.

## Flow
- Working in the studio -> token revoked/expired -> 'redirecting...' -> landing with 'Sign in with Google' -> no reason, and after sign-in the shelf is re-seeded/empty.

## Expected impact
The exact report the docstring predicts ('randomly logged out') gets its one-line answer at the moment it happens; the user learns the session ended rather than that the app is flaky.

## Evaluation
Claim: user - after an expiry I should see that my session ended, not a fresh landing
Before: consumers of lastTransition: 0; distinct landing renders for signed-out / session-ended / account-switched / first visit: 1
After: landing (or AuthGate's redirect) renders a one-chip reason for 'session-ended' and 'account-switched' - e.g. a StaleBadge/Tally-shaped chip from components/ui/signal, <=6 words, with the reason as aria text; 'signed-out' stays silent (the user did it)
Method: simulation - walked onAuthStateChanged(null) -> transitionFor -> evictIdentity -> AuthGate redirect -> EnterButton render branches
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence: lib/useAuth.tsx:67-68, :81-85, :137-141; grep lastTransition outside useAuth.tsx = 0; lib/identityEviction.ts:122 EvictionReason; components/ui/AuthGate.tsx:21-23; app/_landing/parts.tsx:30 (destructures user, loading, signIn, error - not lastTransition).
verify: Probe (source ratchet) tests/golden-path/session-ended-reason.probe.spec.ts: stripComments(app/_landing/parts.tsx) reads `lastTransition` from useAuth and branches on 'session-ended' (red on HEAD). The chip must come from components/ui/signal (no new prose slot, no explanatory sentence - the law), stay <=12 words, and carry an accessible name. Photograph `landing` with pipeline/cx-capture.mjs after forcing the branch.

title: Focus-ring doctrine in globals.css is false: 9 controls still kill the ring
body:
## Summary
app/globals.css:95-102 states 'focus:outline-none no longer appears anywhere in app/ or components/' and 'NOTHING OPTS OUT'; the tree has 5 literal focus:outline-none and 4 more outline-none variants on focusable controls, 5 of them with no replacement indicator at all.

## Description
In Tailwind v4 `outline-none`/`focus:outline-none` live in @layer utilities, which outranks the @layer base :focus-visible ring at globals.css:130-135, so each removes the only focus indicator. Zero-indicator sites (focus state changes nothing): app/playground/arrange/Board.tsx:409 (rename input, static border), :508 (label input, static border), app/playground/hunt/Start.tsx:64 (idea textarea, no border), app/library/FolderTree.tsx:338 (rename input, static border), app/foundry/CullGrid.tsx:400 (`focus-visible:outline-none`, ring only when the APP-state `focused` is true - a Tab-focused tile shows nothing). Tint-only sites, which the doctrine bans in words ('Tint the border as well by all means - do not tint it instead'): app/foundry/ExtractView.tsx:669, app/library/AssetLightbox.tsx:357, app/library/MoveDialog.tsx:166, app/playground/arrange/LabelPrompt.tsx:65 (cyan/emerald border at /40-/50 alpha on ink). Legitimate and excluded: tabIndex={-1} programmatic targets (BoardView.tsx:29, error.tsx:77, triage/Judge.tsx:393) and full replacements (arrange/Card.tsx:85, audio-workbench.css:84,163-164). The same comment's 'Eight files... are the whole list' of focus-visible:outline overrides is 33 files today. No gate exists: grep outline-none pipeline/ tests/ = 0.

## Flow
- Keyboard user in Sound lab -> Arrange -> Tab into the rename field -> no ring, no border change -> types into a field they cannot see is focused.
- Foundry cull -> Tab across tiles -> no ring until a click sets app focus.

## Expected impact
Restores the WCAG 2.4.7 floor the file promises; the doctrine becomes a gate instead of a claim.

## Evaluation
Claim: user - every focusable control shows where focus is
Before: focusable controls defeating the base ring: 9 (5 zero-indicator, 4 tint-only); gate: none; globals.css claim: 0
After: 0 (drop outline-none so the base ring shows, or add an explicit focus-visible:outline-2); probe pins 0 with the tabIndex=-1 exemption; globals.css comment corrected to name the probe instead of a hand list
Method: probe - grep census above, reproduced by tests/golden-path/focus-ring-floor.probe.spec.ts (stripComments; flag outline-none/focus:outline-none/focus-visible:outline-none on an element without tabIndex={-1} and without a focus-visible:outline-/shadow replacement)
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence: grep -rnE '(focus:|focus-visible:)?outline-none|outline: ?none' --include=*.tsx --include=*.css app components: Board.tsx:409,508; Start.tsx:64; FolderTree.tsx:338; CullGrid.tsx:400; ExtractView.tsx:669; AssetLightbox.tsx:357; MoveDialog.tsx:166; LabelPrompt.tsx:65 (+ exempt BoardView.tsx:29, error.tsx:77, Judge.tsx:393, Card.tsx:85). globals.css:95-102 claim, :111-123 'whole list' (actual: grep -rlE focus-visible:outline -> 33 files). grep outline-none pipeline tests -> 0.
verify: Probe first (red on HEAD with 9 offenders listed in the failure message), then remove outline-none / focus:outline-none at the 9 sites (keep any border tint - 'as well', not 'instead'); CullGrid.tsx:400 swaps focus-visible:outline-none for focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-4 beside the existing app-state ring. Rewrite globals.css:95-123 to point at the probe rather than enumerate files. Photograph `playground` and `foundry` via pipeline/cx-capture.mjs with a field focused.

lens_checked.visual-craft: app/globals.css read in full: type-scale @theme (:44-81), focus ring (:130-135), effects (.gt-float/.gt-glow/.gt-rise), scroll grades, indeterminate sweep + reduced-motion block (:351-374); loop census grep animate-(spin|pulse|ping|bounce)|infinite across app/components (comment's 'ten loops' enumeration is stale, but it is a code comment, not rendered - not filed)
lens_checked.ux-reviewer: lib/useAuth.tsx signIn/signOut/redirect-fallback paths; UserMenu.tsx and AuthGate.tsx as its two renderers; lastTransition consumers
lens_checked.state-coverage: useProjects/useThemes/useAssets reload catch branches vs their 4 consumers (ProjectsView, CreateWizard, LibraryAtelier x2)
lens_checked.copy-auditor: useAuth error strings (:123, :156, :171, :175) - rendered only by app/_landing/parts.tsx:76-79 role=alert; the .env.example sentence is an operator/config error (real error, exempt); raw Firebase messages are the vendor's own words (exempt)
lens_checked.accessibility-checker: focus-ring floor vs outline-none census across app/ and components/ (.tsx + .css)

lens_no_surface.mobile-specialist: lib/useAuth.tsx renders no markup; globals.css has no breakpoint rules
